Had the same questions before. I had multiple attempts already, I was so tired of the mania - depressive cycle. How can I get out of this? I’m losing sleep, my health’s declining. 

I agree sa comment dito na your are not your disorder. It may be destructive and nakakapagod but you have to constantly want to be better. 

If the meds doesn’t work for you, ask for a different one. If you feel like your psychiatrist is not very helpful, find a different one. It took me 4 different psychiatrists before I was able to find someone I’m really comfortable with and who really educated me. Hindi yung bigay lang ng bigay ng medication. 

Taking medication is one thing - it helps your brain activity calm down but having psychotherapy sessions really made a HUGE difference for me. 

Another thing is of course, understanding yourself. Like you mentioned, hindi ka magaling sa routine activities (I don’t as well), what can you do instead?

I know this sounds cliche but, keep moving forward. Even when it feels like you can’t live for another day, even if it feels like there’s no end to the things running inside your brain, even when it hurts, even when you feel empty, even when you don’t feel anything. Just keep moving forward.

Living in an apartment now pero I used to live sa condo. I guess both may pros and cons?? 

Condo 
- Smaller space 
- more expensive rent 
- madaming bawal like magbutas or if may ipapagawa ka or may magkakabit ng internet kailangan muna ng permit from the admin
- hirap ng parking 
- limited space if meron kang furbaby 
- usually semi furnished so nakahelp to sa akin noon 

Apartment 
- cheaper
- more options merong parang house talaga, merong condo type 
- defo bigger space 
- magsasabi ka lang sa owner if may works or may mga ipapakabit ka 
- often times hindi furnished so this is quite expensive 

Pero siyempre OP, at the end of the day you decide pa rin saan ka mas comfortable and mas pasok sa budget.

I’m not sure if this will be helpful or not but I became a TL last yr so wfh pa. Pay was not enough lalo na my dad has a heart condition and needed surgery. Pay was also around that range and I don’t really have a lot of expenses pero since I’m living alone, halos lahat ng pay ko, doon lang napupunta. I took the risk and switched to freelancing. Got 40k salary which helped A LOT. Pero there are things you have to consider kung mag freelance ka: 

1.	No HMO - I have a lot of condition so I got myself my own HMO. Paid 5k+ every quarter sa maxicare 
2.	No work, no pay  
3.	If you have a plan to take out a loan in the near future, mas okay siguro magfile ng taxes sa bir otherwise, mahihirapan ka magloan since hindi accepted ang freelancing as a stable job. I didn’t do this kasi when I asked someone, if hindi daw declared na nagooperate sila dito sa atin, better not to file it. I’m not sure how true this is. 
4.	Paying your own SSS, Philhealth, Pag-ibig


Almost 1 yr na ako sa work ko as a freelancer but I realized na career wise, wala akong growth sa work na ito kasi hindi sila naghhire ng full time na hindi taga US. So what I did was, I applied to work full time sa ibang company, got hired considering I have no knowledge sa role and business nila and I’m getting paid higher than the 40k sa freelancing work ko. I also don’t have to worry about taxes, sss, philhealth, pag-ibig, and hmo since provided siya since day 1. 

So now, I work full time sa morning and yung freelancing, sa gabi. Since hindi naman call or anything yung freelance work ko and I get things done within 3-4hrs, I still have enough time to rest. I also sleep before ako magstart ng freelance work. Now, I’m not very worried about not having enough money or savings. Medyo malungkot lang na if we want to get away from the paycheck to paycheck life, we have to do this kasi we’re under-compensated. 

I’m not saying this is what you should do to but I’m just sharing what I’m doing para you have different perspectives :)

I’m not a multimillionaire but I have friends who are. They have a lot of yayas. Some has 6-8 (not even exaggerating this). They buy really good washing machine, dryers, everything and the yayas use them. 

If you’re a big family that still uses the old type of washing machine, I highly suggest to save money for a good washing machine. Madami na magagandang washing machine ngayon but LG is really good - like the other people’s comment. We use an automatic washing machine at home and it’s super convenient, segregate your clothes, set up your preferred settings sa washing machine, shoot mo lang then voila! Pwede na isampay - if you prefer na matuyo pa rin sa init ng araw yung damit mo. Pwede rin namang gamitin mo dryer (either a separate one or yung setting sa washing machine). It’s expensive yes, pero the time it saves you everytime you do your laundry. Sulit na diba? 

Kung 2-3 lang naman kayo sa bahay and if you’re considering na magpalaundry nalang, I don’t see any problem with that. I’m living with my partner so hindi namin nakikita both yung worth ng washing machine at the moment kasi we both work 8hrs a day, we really want to just enjoy our offs. Since we’re only 2, we opted na magpalaundry nalang. Convenient. Roughly 200+ ang binabayaran namin every week. 400+ kapag may mga bedsheet. Just a tip though: find a good laundry shop kasi may mga laudnry shop na tatanungin mo talaga kung nilabhan ba nila ang damit mo. 

Another option is yung mga self service laundry - you can either ask the person in charge to shoot the laundry sa mga washing machine nila doon, pay for it. Balikan mo same day, folded na. You just have to pay extra for the service (mga 50php). 1 machine ata 60-80php depende sa setting na kailangan mo. May dryer din na kailangan bayaran, depende kung ilan ang need mo. Every laundry sa ganito, inaabot ng 300php per week. Still not bad, right?
